name: Vault 9 Revisited
description: Ironbark has located what appears to be the southern hemisphere's only Vault-Tec installation near Alice Springs. The vault may still be sealed, or its inhabitants may have already emerged. Either way, it's worth checking.

stages.name: Cross the Outback
stages.description: The trek from Sydney to Alice Springs through the irradiated Outback is no small thing. Navigate the wasteland terrain, water rationing critical in the deep interior.

stages.name: Find the Vault Entrance
stages.description: Ironbark's coordinates put the vault entrance in the red rock formation northwest of the old township. Search the area carefully — the entrance won't be obvious.

stages.name: Investigate Vault Status
stages.description: Determine whether Vault 9 is still sealed, already open, or somewhere in between. Document what you find and report back to Ironbark in Sydney.
